irrigation.title: Irrigation Support & Water Management
irrigation.desc: Guidance for canal water distribution from the Krishna Western Delta, micro-irrigation subsidies under APMIP, water-saving techniques, and water shortage reporting for Prathuru & Gundimeda.
irrigation.canalDesc: Primary water source for paddy in Prathuru and Gundimeda via the Krishna Western Delta canal branch. Rotational turn system (Warabandi) ensures fair water flow to tail-end cultivators.
irrigation.canalPoint2: Silt cleaning coordinated via Water Users Associations (WUA)
irrigation.dripDesc: Highly recommended for Chilli, Cotton, and Vegetable farmers in our area. Delivers moisture and soluble fertilizers (fertigation) directly to the root zone with zero runoff loss.
irrigation.dripPoint1: Up to 60% water savings vs flood irrigation
irrigation.dripCrops: Applicable for: Chilli, Tomato, Brinjal, Banana
irrigation.sprinklerDesc: Ideal for close-growing crops like pulses, groundnut, and maize. Creates simulated rainfall to provide uniform wetting and temperature cooling during hot dry spells.
irrigation.sprinklerPoint1: Uniform coverage on undulating delta land
irrigation.sprinklerPoint3: Quick portable setup across multiple plots
irrigation.sprinklerCrops: Applicable for: Maize, Black Gram, Green Gram

irrigation.calcNote: * Note: Estimates are based on APMIP baseline benchmark costs. Final quote depends on field surveying at Rythu Seva Kendram.

about.title: About RythuSahayam
about.desc: A centralized digital agriculture and farmers' welfare support platform engineered specifically for the rural farming communities of Prathuru and Gundimeda in Tadepalli Mandal, Guntur District, Andhra Pradesh.
about.missionDesc: To eliminate information asymmetry faced by rural cultivators by providing direct access to verified MSP mandi rates, Krishna Western Delta canal schedules, subsidized inputs, and digital grievance resolution.
about.villagesDesc: Focused on the riverside villages of Prathuru and Gundimeda situated along the Krishna riverbed in Tadepalli Mandal, where intensive Paddy, Chilli, Cotton, and vegetable farming is practiced.
about.communityDesc: Developed as an applied academic Community Service Project (CSP) to bridge the gap between grassroots farmers and Village Agriculture Assistants (VAAs) at local Rythu Seva Kendrams (RSK).
about.l1Desc: Field inspections, e-Crop survey, soil sampling
about.l2Desc: Complaint escalation, subsidy verification, seed stock
about.l3Desc: Policy enforcement, canal water release coordination
